# Marian Fusek

> Brand, UI, AI & Visual Designer, Creative Director, and Mindset Coach for digital creatives, founders, and leaders.

## Profile

Marian Fusek is a Brand, UI, AI & Visual Designer and Creative Director. He builds brand identities, digital products, and visual systems, and produces with AI as part of the creative process. He also works as a mindset coach for digital creatives — 20+ years of experience.

## Main page

- [Portfolio and profile](https://marianfusek.com/): Recent work, services, bio, initiatives, and contact information.

## Areas of expertise

- Brand identity
- Creative direction
- Visual design
- Product & UX/UI design
- AI-assisted production
- Pitch & sales decks
- Web builds
- Mindset coaching
- Team leadership

## Recent work

- MIUNĀE — Creative direction and a skincare brand system built around time, tactility and restraint
- GoBaller — Brand and iOS app for football coaching, for players of all ages
- AIMS — Website, brand refresh, marketing and sales assets for the most advanced AI search for music catalogs

## Initiatives

- Vibe-coding apps — self-built apps and tools (A-Void, Taiki, Aww-wake, Kokoji, Wezzaa, And Then, Terracoda)
- Visual Remnants — self-directed visual/design experiments (Very Much Art, Leftovers)
- Side Quests — community, mentorship, and product work outside client projects (Tomas Bata University dissertation committee, Ūndersurface co-founder, Femme Palette mentor, Nollie creative studio co-founder, NEXT.WORKOUT launch product manager)
